data.title: 画室午后的松节油与淡紫颜料
data.location: 洒满斜阳的顶楼美术画室
data.camera: 画架与调色板前景中景
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, cream chunky knit off-shoulder sweater, caramel corduroy pinafore dress, wool beret, paint smudge on cheek, holding paintbrush, palette, leaning beside wooden easel, head tilt, amused blush, looking at viewer, art studio, easel foreground, canvas, skylight sunlight, warm dust particles, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Peeking past the edge of a wooden easel with a dab of lilac paint on her cheek, she holds a wet brush aloft and tilts her head in flustered amusement. Tall studio skylights cast crisp warm sunlight across her chunky cream knit sweater and caramel corduroy straps.
data.promptProse: Framed past the blurred edge of a paint-stained wooden easel and canvas in the foreground, Ayachi Nene stands in a bright attic art studio wearing a cozy cream chunky-knit sweater layered under a caramel corduroy pinafore dress and a soft beret. Holding a wooden palette in one hand and a fine brush in the other, she leans slightly around the easel with an accidental streak of pale violet paint across one cheek, blushing when you point it out. Slanted natural light pours from high atelier skylights, catching dust motes, glass jars of brushes, and the textured ribs of her corduroy dress.
data.story: 顶楼画室飘着淡淡的松节油味。宁宁原本专心给背景调色，被你提醒脸颊蹭到了淡紫颜料，捏着画笔手足无措地侧过头，越想擦反而把鼻尖也抹了一点——「别、别光顾着笑啦，帮我递一下干净手帕嘛！」
